subject: general
question:
Match the points under List I with those under List II (mountain peaks and their heights). 

 
 

 
 
List-I (Mountain peak)

 
 
 
List-II (height in m)

 
 
 

 
 
(1)

 
 Kamet
 
 
a.

 
 7756
 
 

 
 
(2)

 
 Kangchenjunga
 
 
b.

 
 7816
 
 

 
 
(3)

 
 Nanda Devi
 
 
c.

 
 8611
 
 

 
 
(4)

 
 K2
 
 
d.

 
 8586
solution:
The correct answer is __**1 - a, 2 - d, 3 - b, 4 - c.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kamet**, in the **Garhwal region **of the Himalayas in India, is **7756 m **high
 
• **Kangchenjunga**, a part of the Himalayan range present between Nepal and the Indian state of Sikkim, is** 8586 m **tall
 
• **Nanda Devi**, located in the Garhwal Himalayas, has a height of **7816 m**
 
• **K2**, also known as Mount Godwin-Austen or Chhogori, part of the Karakoram Range, located in the Ladakh Union Territory of India (a disputed territory between India and Pakistan), stands as the second-highest peak in the world with its height of **8611 m**.

***Therefore, the correct option is 1 - a, 2 - d, 3 - b, 4 - c.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kamet:**

 
 
• Kamet is the mountain peak in the Garhwal region of Uttarakhand, India.
 
• It lies very close to the border with Tibet, making its location geopolitically strategical.
 
• The **first successful ascent** to Kamet was made in **1931 by a team led by British mountaineer Frank Smythe.**
 
• At 7756 meters, it is the third-highest peak in India and **29th highest in the world**.
 
• Kamet is known for its unique,** pyramid-like shape** and is often touted as a challenging peak to conquer due to harsh weather conditions and technical climbing sections.
 
 
 
• **Kangchenjunga:**
 
 
• Kangchenjunga, located on the border between Nepal and the Indian state of Sikkim, is the **third-highest mountain in the world.**
 
• It stands tall with a height of** 8586 meters.**
 
• **The first successful ascent** was made by** Joe Brown and George Band in 1955 **as a part of a British expedition. They stopped a few meters short of the actual summit in deference to the local culture that considers the peak sacred.
 
• Kangchenjunga, meaning** "Five Treasures of Snow,"** refers to its five peaks that are said to represent the five repositories of God - gold, silver, gems, grain, and holy books.
 
• The surrounding area is rich in biodiversity and is recognized as a conservation area.
 
 
 
• **Nanda Devi:**
 
 
• Nanda Devi is located in the** Garhwal region of Uttarakhand, India.**
 
• In addition to being** India's second-highest peak, **it is also considered one of the most beautiful, with its twin peaks providing a stunning spectacle.
 
• Nanda Devi peaks stand at a height of** 7816 meters.**
 
• It is surrounded by the** Nanda Devi National Park, declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1988**, home to several endangered species and a unique high-altitude flora.
 
• The peaks of Nanda Devi are considered sacred in local culture, and multiple legends and folk tales revolve around them.
 
 
 
• **K2:**
 
 
• Known as K2, the peak is also dubbed **Mount Godwin-Austen or Chhogori.**
 
• K2, at **8611 meters**, is the **second-highest mountain peak globally**, surpassed only by Mount Everest.
 
• This mountain is reputed to be the most challenging to climb due to its severe weather and difficult ascent routes.
 
• Unlike Everest, which has been successfully climbed by thousands, K2 has only a few hundred successful ascents to its name due to its extreme difficulty.
 
• One significant feature of K2 is the lack of any easy routes to the top. This towering peak is often considered the 'Mountaineers' Mountain' due to its challenging ascent.
